quote: Background: Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) is a synthetic chemical ubiquitous in the serum of U.S. residents.

value: C8 Health Project
quote: A pretrial settlement required DuPont to provide funding for an independent community health study called the C8 Health Project ( C8 Health Project 2012 ; Frisbee et al. 2009 ), and also resulted in the creation of the C8 Science Panel ( C8 Science Panel 2012 ), which was tasked with determining whether there was a probable link between PFOA and disease in the community living near the plant.

value: survivor cohort
quote: Because this is largely a survivor cohort, findings must be interpreted with caution, especially for highly fatal cancers such as pancreatic and lung cancer.
